name: Yasugi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yasugi city emblem in green, orange and blue: a green stylised swoosh with an orange disc and a blue stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Yasugi, a city in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Yasugi city emblem — a green stylised swoosh with an orange disc and a blue stroke
